messages:
morgan: Monitoring alerted — dub3 control-plane heartbeats gone for ~6m, edge 5xx spike. alerts: region-heartbeat-missing:dub3. I’m starting triage.

sasha_oncall: Copy. Seeing same in dashboards — controlplane-api latency → timeout, kube-apiserver not responding to probes. Rolling up runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/dub3-controlplane (link).

infra-bot: AUTOMATION: Region dub3 heartbeat absent. Notified oncall. Attempting API probe: curl -I https://controlplane.dub3.redwood.internal -> timeout.

hk: Can someone run basic node checks? `for n in $(kubectl get nodes -l region=dub3 -o name); do kubectl describe $n | grep -E "NotReady|NetworkUnavailable"; done`

eli: Ran quick node check from bastion: ~40% nodes NotReady, lots of kubelet restarts in last 10m. snippet: `kubelet[123]: E0109 21:40:12 ... network plugin timed out`

netops: BGP peering logs show flaps to dub3 edge routers ~21:34→21:38. Looks like an external network flap possibly coinciding with dataplane issues. Escalating to cloud provider NOC.

morgan: Initial impact summary: Hosted API region dub3 is effectively offline for new control plane ops — inference hosts still serving cached KV for some sessions but scheduling/scale ops failing. Customer-facing 5xxs for a subset of requests routed to dub3.

sasha_oncall: Action items: 1) Shift traffic off dub3 (automated routing fallback), 2) Reserve capacity in fallback regions (lon1/dub1), 3) Run quick config to prevent double-scheduling. I’ll kick off traffic splay now.

deploy-bot: ACTION: Starting traffic splay: 60% -> lon1, 40% -> dub1. Rolling update to edge-proxies to change origin routing. ETA ~3m.

infra-bot: CHECK: Canary test after splay — `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.redwood.com/health` returning 200 from lon1, 200 from dub1. Some 503s still observed for sessions pinned to dub3.

hk: Good. Starting capacity reservation: `reservation --region=lon1 --gpu-count=24 --ttl=2h` and `reservation --region=dub1 --gpu-count=12 --ttl=2h`. Also disabling autoscaler in dub3 to avoid noisy churn.

eli: Notifying customer-success about partial outage for EU customers and potential rate limits. Draft message: "We're actively routing traffic away from dub3 after detection of a region control-plane issue; you may see transient errors as sessions migrate." Approving now.

netops: Provider NOC response: show details of backbone maintenance affecting subset of racks, possible fabric control-plane instability. They are investigating. Original incident ID CPX-8921.

morgan: Next steps: keep traffic splayed, monitor KV cache hit rates and error budgets, attempt to drain pods gracefully from dub3 if control-plane becomes reachable. If provider confirms fabric issue, prep for extended failover and customer advisory.

sasha_oncall: Paging infra-eng lead @hk and platform oncall, please confirm if we should start cross-region failover for Dedicated pools (higher risk).

hk: I recommend failover for Dedicated—triggering manual failover now for committed pools and marking dub3 as degraded. Running `redwoodctl failover-region --from=dub3 --to=lon1 --pools=dedicated --confirm`

infra-bot: NOTE: Automatic failover disabled for some tenants with strict locality rules — those will need manual outreach.

eli: Logged customer-impact: INC-21765, CISCO/fintech tier flagged for manual contact.

morgan: Thanks all. Keep thread updated with provider NOC ETA and error-rate numbers. Tag me for any production-correcting actions. :phone: :rotating_light:

netops: Provider NOC updated: investigating power/redundant-fabric control-plane on affected POPs, ETA unknown. Will push updates to this thread.

sasha_oncall: Current metrics (post-splay): 5xx rate global down from 7%→1.2%, dub3 internal 5xx ~85%. We’re stable for now. Leaving splay in place until provider clears.

morgan: Steering to postmortem once resolved. Assigning owners: morgan (incident lead), sasha_oncall (ops lead), hk (infra lead), netops (network liaise).

deploy-bot: DEPLOY: Reverted any in-progress control-plane upgrades in dub3 per hold policy.

infra-bot: AUTO NOTE: If dub3 heartbeat returns, do NOT automatically shift traffic back — require manual verification and canary checks.

sasha_oncall: Logged timeline and actions in incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/2176543210 (internal). Will update when provider responds.

netops: Provider NOC: CPX-8921 -> fabric control plane unit replaced minutes ago, but still monitoring. Next update in 20m.

morgan: Acknowledged. Standby for updates.
